PLANNED audio/windows probe: Windows' microphone-in-use record (CapabilityAccessManager ConsentStore\microphone\NonPackaged, LastUsedTimeStop = 0) or an open capture session owned by Discord. Heuristic: also true during a mic test in Settings.

contexts.verify: No shipped detector yet. (1) With a BYO Discord app authorized for rpc, call GET_SELECTED_VOICE_CHANNEL while in and out of a call. userBindings.summary: Custom keybinds (Settings > Keybinds) live in Discord's Chromium Local Storage for https://discord.com under the key 'keybinds' (KeybindsStore, a device-settings store). That same LevelDB holds the account token, so Prism must NOT read it. Built-in shortcuts (the Ctrl+/ list) are not rebindable.

locations.note: Stable. Contains the auth token: do not open. Absent on this PC (no %APPDATA%\discord folder; names-only probe).
Desktop-host settings (window, startup, hardware acceleration). Believed not to hold keybinds.

userBindings.entryShape: Value of localStorage['keybinds']: an object keyed by keybind id ('0','1',…; managed defaults use fixed ids such as '1001' for the overlay lock). Each entry: { id, action (PUSH_TO_TALK, PUSH_TO_TALK_PRIORITY, PUSH_TO_MUTE, TOGGLE_MUTE, TOGGLE_DEAFEN, TOGGLE_CAMERA, TOGGLE_VOICE_MODE, TOGGLE_STREAMER_MODE, TOGGLE_GO_LIVE_STREAMING, TOGGLE_OVERLAY_INPUT_LOCK, SOUNDBOARD, SOUNDBOARD_HOLD, SAVE_CLIP, SAVE_SCREENSHOT, SWITCH_TO_VOICE_CHANNEL, DISCONNECT_FROM_VOICE_CHANNEL, NAVIGATE_BACK, NAVIGATE_FORWARD, …), shortcut: [[deviceType, code, env], …], enabled, managed, params { channelId? }, context? }. action is the join key with verb.appAction.
userBindings.keyNameMap: deviceType 0 = keyboard key, 1 = mouse button (code = button number), 2 = keyboard modifier, 3 = gamepad button. env 1 = Windows, 2 = macOS, 3 = Linux, 4 = browser. With env 1 the code is the Windows virtual-key: 160/161 LShift/RShift, 162/163 LCtrl/RCtrl, 164/165 LAlt/RAlt, 91 LWin, 65-90 A-Z, 48-57 0-9, 112-135 F1-F24, 33/34 PageUp/PageDown, 37-40 Left/Up/Right/Down, 186 Semicolon, 187 Equal, 188 Comma, 189 Minus, 190 Period, 191 Slash, 192 Backquote, 219 BracketLeft, 220 Backslash, 221 BracketRight, 222 Quote. Mouse buttons cannot be sent as chords: map to mouse bindings.
userBindings.readMode: DO NOT READ. Reading Discord's Local Storage is what token stealers do; AV/EDR flags it and it would expose the account token. Prism keeps the defaults above and asks the user in the PI which keys they recorded for Push to Talk / Toggle Mute / Disconnect etc. (a short form keyed by action). A future RPC module still cannot read keybinds (RPC has no keybind command).
userBindings.verify: Store key, entry shape and VK coding come from Discord's code (S5/S6); the leveldb location from S12. Whether the value is wrapped (e.g. {"_state":…,"_version":…}) is unverified and should stay that way: verify only on a throwaway VM profile, never on the user's PC.

layouts.rationale: Voice toggles and the switcher on top, chat tools in the middle rows, back/read/answer at the bottom; channel and server browsing on the left dial, Discord volume and unread triage on the right.
Mute/deafen stay in the same top-left keys as in chat (muscle memory) with hang-up (confirm) beside them; call tools in the middle, Windows mic as a backstop bottom-right; levels on the left dial.
Same top row as the Galleon; four dials give channels, servers, scrolling and Discord volume, with the strip showing the channel, mic and volume.
Call controls on the keys with mute/deafen in the same spots as chat; levels on the first two dials, navigation on the last two.

conflicts: Background behavior of Ctrl+Shift+M / Ctrl+Shift+D: S3 (2024) says both work while Discord is in the background; live code S5 binds them in-app only, and the April build S6 only natively registered Ctrl+Shift+M behind a config flag. Treat them as in-app; use audio.micMute or user-set Discord keybinds from a game.
Start a call: S1 Ctrl+[ vs S3/S5 Ctrl+'.
Alt+Left / Alt+Right: S1 'return to connected audio channel' / 'previous text channel' vs S2/S5 Navigate back / forward.
Ctrl+Alt+Right/Left: S2 'switch between servers' vs S5 previous-server toggle / return to audio channel (servers are Ctrl+Alt+Up/Down in S1 and S5).

Ctrl+B, Ctrl+I, Ctrl+U: S1 previous channel / mentions / member list vs S2 bold / italic / underline in the message box. In S5 Ctrl+B is no longer a navigation shortcut; Ctrl+I opens the Inbox and Ctrl+U the member list unless text is selected in the editor.
Return to audio channel: S1 Ctrl+Alt+A vs S5 Ctrl+Alt+Left (plus Jump to current call Ctrl+Alt+Shift+V).
RPC access: S8 allows up to 50 testers on an unapproved app, S9 says the rpc/rpc.voice.* scopes are for approved partners only.
gaps: No working way yet to know if the user is in a call (inCall detector is planned/unverified).
Discord's own mute/deafen state is unreadable without the planned RPC module; MUTE/DEAFEN keys are toggles with a guessed state.
Mute/deafen/disconnect while a game is in front need either audio.micMute (exists) or keybinds the user records in Discord; this pack only applies while Discord is in front.
User rebinds cannot be read safely (token store); the PI must ask the user.
Window title format for the channel readout not checked on this PC (Discord has no user data here).
Channel tabs (Ctrl+T open, Ctrl+W close, Ctrl+Shift+P pin) and Create thread (Ctrl+Alt+Shift+N) appear in build 641004 but are likely experiment-gated; not added.
Message actions in Keyboard Mode (Tab then E edit, R reply, + react, P pin, F forward, Backspace delete, Alt+Enter mark unread) need a focused message; not added.
notes: Excluded on purpose: BROWSER_DEVTOOLS (Ctrl+Alt+I in code), the 'vibe with Wumpus' easter egg (Ctrl+Alt+Shift+W), Create server (Ctrl+Shift+N) and Create group DM (Ctrl+Shift+T).

Do not use these Discord pages in a browser with this pack: browser-reserved chords (Ctrl+T/W/N, Ctrl+Shift+T/N) never reach the page. A discord-web site pack should extend the browser pack and drop them.
